categories.main_business_segments: Lithia Motors operates two primary business segments: Vehicle Operations and Financing Operations. Vehicle Operations encompasses all automotive merchandising and service activities including new and used vehicle retail sales, finance and insurance products, and service, body and parts operations across 344 locations in the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada. Financing Operations provides captive auto loan and lease financing to customers purchasing vehicles from the company's stores and through its Driveway e-commerce platform.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary data science and performance measurement systems to drive operational excellence and customer loyalty. Core technologies include owned e-commerce platforms (Driveway.com and GreenCars.com), a proprietary customer lifecycle communication platform for managing customer data internally, proprietary credit models for auto loan underwriting, and digital shopping experiences including contactless test drives and home delivery capabilities. The company also utilizes securitization and warehouse facilities to fund its auto loan portfolio.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Lithia serves individual consumers purchasing new and used vehicles, as well as customers seeking automotive financing, insurance, and service solutions. The company operates across diverse geographic markets in the United States (90% of revenue), United Kingdom (6%), and Canada (4%), serving customers through 344 physical retail locations and online platforms. The company offers 47 brands of new vehicles and all brands of used vehicles, serving both retail and fleet customers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates 344 locations across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada as of December 31, 2023. The United States represents the largest market with 90% of total revenue and 92% of gross profit, while the United Kingdom contributes 6% of revenue and 5% of gross profit, and Canada contributes 4% of revenue and 3% of gross profit. The company maintains coast-to-coast coverage in North America with operations in metropolitan and mid-sized regional markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: Lithia operates as a downstream retailer in the automotive supply chain, purchasing new vehicles from manufacturers and distributors and selling them to end consumers. The company also operates midstream in the used vehicle market, acquiring used vehicles through trade-ins and wholesale purchases, then reselling them to consumers. Additionally, the company provides downstream services including financing, insurance, and vehicle maintenance and repair services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include driving operational excellence through digital modernization and e-commerce expansion, particularly through its Driveway and GreenCars platforms. Key R&D and innovation initiatives focus on developing omni-channel retail experiences, expanding captive financing capabilities through Driveway Finance Corporation, advancing electric vehicle education and sales through GreenCars, and implementing proprietary data science solutions for customer retention and market share optimization. The company also invests in technology infrastructure to support seamless online and physical retail integration.
categories.revenue_model: Lithia generates revenue through multiple streams: new vehicle retail sales (48.8% of 2023 revenue), used vehicle retail sales (30.8%), used vehicle wholesale (4.3%), finance and insurance products (4.3%), service, body and parts operations (10.3%), and fleet and other services (1.5%). The company also generates financing income through its captive auto loan and lease portfolio. Revenue is primarily transaction-based from vehicle sales and service work, supplemented by recurring revenue from finance and insurance products and financing operations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Lithia competes with over 16,500 new vehicle franchise dealers in the United States, 4,500 in the UK, and 3,400 in Canada, ranging from independent operators to large retail groups. Major competitors include publicly-traded retailers such as AutoNation, Penske Automotive Group, Sonic Automotive, Group 1 Automotive, and Asbury Automotive Group, as well as used-only retailers like CarMax, Carvana, and Cazoo. The company is ranked #145 on the Fortune 500 and positions itself as one of the largest global automotive retailers with significant financial resources and scale advantages over most regional competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: Lithia is a large-cap automotive retailer with 2023 total revenues of $31.0 billion, up 10.1% from $28.2 billion in 2022. Net income attributable to Lithia Motors was $1.0 billion in 2023 compared to $1.3 billion in 2022. The company has demonstrated consistent growth through acquisitions, acquiring 56 stores in 2023 and 31 stores in 2022, with annualized revenues from 2023 acquisitions expected to add $3.8 billion. The company maintains strong liquidity with $1.7 billion in available funds as of December 31, 2023.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Lithia emphasizes a customer-centric value proposition centered on 'Earn Customers for Life' through convenient, transparent, and hassle-free experiences across the entire vehicle ownership lifecycle. Key differentiators include its integrated omni-channel platform combining physical stores with e-commerce solutions, proprietary data science capabilities for personalized customer engagement, no-haggle pricing transparency on Driveway, a 7-day money-back guarantee, captive financing solutions through Driveway Finance Corporation, and comprehensive service offerings. The company also differentiates through its GreenCars platform providing electric vehicle education and incentive information, and its ability to offer 47 vehicle brands with extensive inventory selection.
